purpose: Bounded experimental full-length training with meaningful authored evidence labels; not a general-quality claim.
training_selection: Deterministic label-by-position balanced subset covering all three training source groups, independent of validation and test results.
checkpoint_selection: None: use the fixed ninth-step checkpoint, report even if worse.
evaluation: All 27 held-out test rows at matched short and long lengths; all 27 validation rows at long length. Compare with frozen-base runs already queued.
limitations: Tiny templated authored set; only three training source groups.
One seed and microbatch one diverge from the main two-seed effective-batch-16 recipes.
Main CLINC/WANLI adapters remain separately trained at 2048 tokens.
start_gate: Completed finite-gradient 262144-token systems probe, CPU tests and code review, and sole GPU availability after base evaluation.
